script: My boss tried to destroy us; I caught his ruthless secret—watch.. I was stuck in a tiny IT office, a cozy spot with a southern view, when the company decided to hire a pompous PhD who'd written a book on marketing. He strutted in, saying we were all doing it wrong, even though he knew nothing about our field. He was a BS artist, loved by management, and he claimed he'd make us all rich with his "revolutionary" research. (I mean, he earned a PhD in marketing—he wasn't curing cancer, right?) He thought he was smarter than everyone, even though our revenue came from the computer system we IT folks built and customized. So he wanted the IT office. The company said, "We'll move you two to a smaller office that barely fits one person, but you'll share it." And they told us to move out the SAME DAY they moved him in. (The audacity!) While I was scrambling to pack, I grabbed a chair, pushed the AC vent up into the ceiling, and slid a spare tile over it. I did the same with the air return, sealing the place. We left, and he moved in. The first day, he slammed his door shut, hiding from everyone. I later found out he spent hours playing Solitaire—classic revenge, right? It was May in North Carolina—heat already crawling. By June, he'd show up to meetings visibly sweating. He never called maintenance about the temperature. Guess even a PhD can't fix a broken AC. (Honestly, it was like watching a car crash in slow motion.)
